description: Account value and PnL history for one Hyperliquid wallet address over a day, week, month or all time -- starting and ending account value, PnL change, trading volume, then a downsampled series. Scope "combined" is perp plus spot; "perp" is perp only. Public on-chain data, keyless. e.g. {address:"0x31dea2516beee92135b96f464eeec3cf292a13f2", period:"week"}.
name: hyperliquid_account_history
